title: Worker publication is operator-gated: deterministic guard plus adapter deny defaults
summary: control_plane.publication_check fails any orchestrated editing node (every repository) whose worker transcript shows an executed publishing command (git push, package publish/upload, gh release/pr/repo create, docker push, outbound curl or Invoke-WebRequest with POST/PUT/PATCH). Only executed commands count -- Codex --json command_execution events and shell-prompt log lines -- so prose such as 'I did not git push' never triggers it. Adapter defaults add a first layer: Claude Code editing workers get --disallowedTools publishing patterns; Codex workspace-write workers get sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=false explicitly. Operator-only opt-outs: run policy allow_worker_publication, provider option allow_publishing. Limits: Claude Code's JSON output has no command transcript, so for it the deny rule is the enforcement; the guard's patterns are a deny-list, not an allow-list. Mutation score of the guard functions 0.87 (20/23; survivors equivalent or cosmetic).

prior_art.checked: PA-openhands (sandbox), PA-camel, Codex/Claude CLI sandbox and permission options (CLI help 2026-09-29)
